# CI/CD Rules

These rules govern continuous integration and deployment pipelines.

## Quality Gates

- All PRs must pass: lint, typecheck, unit tests, spec validation, drift check
- Run `/check` locally before creating a PR
- Never skip CI checks or add `[skip ci]` to bypass validation
- Never use `--no-verify` to skip git hooks

## Workflow Security

- Pin all GitHub Actions to full commit SHAs (not tags)
- Never hardcode secrets in workflow files — use GitHub Secrets
- Reference secrets via `secrets.MY_SECRET`, never as plain text
- Renovate manages action version updates via PR

## Reproducibility

- Use `--frozen-lockfile` (pnpm) or `--ci` (npm) in CI
- Pin Node.js and runtime versions explicitly
- Do not use `latest` tags for base images — pin specific versions

## Pipeline Design

- Fail fast on lint/typecheck failures before running expensive tests
- Spec validation and drift check must run on every PR to main
- The `template-protection.yml` workflow gates changes to `.agentkit/` source
